facts.statement: Independent sweep of every .cs file in the three projects (Domain 61, Application 457, Plugin 70 = 588 files; the only other files are 3 .csproj; the extract has no obj/ or bin/). A comment- and string-stripping classifier assigned every declaration that carries the static modifier to one of: static class, method, operator, const, field (readonly or not), get-only auto-property, expression-bodied property, event or static constructor. Two independent greps then cross-checked the result.
facts.evidence: Classifier totals. Domain: 12 static classes, 16 methods, 1 prop{}, 1 prop=>. Application: 248 static classes, 2234 methods, 38 operators, 84 static readonly fields, 1 non-readonly field, 30 get-only props, 31 prop=>, 4 inline static lambdas (e.g. ProjectVariables/SelectiveLinkedProperties.cs:154). Plugin: 28 static classes, 210 methods, 3 static readonly fields, 4 non-readonly fields, 1 prop{}, 1 prop=>. Cross-check greps: 'static readonly' gives Domain 0, Application 84, Plugin 3. 'static ... { get; }' gives 1, 30, 1. Three classifier leftovers were read by hand and are methods or computed properties: Systems/PushBack/PushBackBedSlope.cs:33,37 and Systems/Shared/RackAuthoredComparator.cs:67-68.

facts.statement: None of these three projects has any static constructor, [ModuleInitializer], [ThreadStatic], ThreadLocal, AsyncLocal, Lazy<, LazyInitializer, ConditionalWeakTable, MemoryCache, static event (no 'event' keyword at all), Interlocked, or static property with set/init. There are also no writes to HostApplicationServices.WorkingDatabase, no SetSystemVariable, no SetEnvironmentVariable, no CurrentCulture assignment and no AssemblyResolve hook. PluginInitializer (IExtensionApplication) has empty Initialize and Terminate methods.
facts.evidence: The classifier found 0 static ctors and 0 events. The grep for ThreadStatic|ThreadLocal|AsyncLocal|Lazy<|ModuleInitializer|static event|event |volatile|Interlocked|WorkingDatabase|SetSystemVariable|AssemblyResolve|SetEnvironmentVariable matched only src/RackCad.Application/Diagnostics/RackLog.cs:18 (volatile) and src/RackCad.Plugin/PluginInitializer.cs:5. PluginInitializer.cs:7-13 has empty bodies. The grep for 'static ... { get; (private )?set|init' returned no hits.

limitations: The sweep is static text analysis: a comment- and string-stripping line classifier plus greps. A declaration whose modifiers and type span unusual line breaks could be misparsed. Only 3 lines were unparsed, and all 3 were read by hand. Two independent greps agree with the counts (84/3 static readonly, 30/1/1 get-only static props, 5 non-readonly static fields).

The governed 'seam' was not defined in the task text I received. I traced reachability along RACKSELECTIVO/RACKCAD -> DrawSelectiveView -> SelectivePlantaDrawService/SelectiveFrontalDrawService -> ViewBlockDraw -> SystemBlockWriter -> BlockLibraryImporter (RackSelectivoCommands.cs:26-46,429-521). Entries whose YES/NO depends on edit, redraw, BOM or comparator paths are marked UNCERTAIN.

Writer searches for shared mutable objects (RackCatalog entries, RackFrameTemplate, arrays, sentinels) are name- and pattern-based. They cannot exclude writes through aliases, reflection, serializers populating existing instances, or casts written in forms the patterns do not match.

Framework behavior is not visible in the repo and is UNCERTAIN: System.Text.Json freezing and metadata caching on static JsonSerializerOptions, JsonDocumentOptions being a struct, AutoCAD per-document command-class instance lifetime, and Database handle retention.

RackCad.UI was out of scope and was not swept exhaustively. A quick check found at least 4 non-readonly static fields there (EditorClosePolicy.cs:51, ShellResources.cs:16, SelectiveCabeceraHeightPrompt.cs:21-22), and the RACKSELECTIVO command enters that project through RackSelectiveWindow (RackSelectivoCommands.cs:31).

Counts include members in all kinds (Cantilever, Dynamic, PushBack, etc.), not only those reachable from the Selective seam. Tier B means mutable by declared type with no writer found. It does not mean shown to be mutated at runtime.
No files were created or modified. All analysis ran as read-only shell/python-stdin commands against the main2 extract of commit 3375aadb.
